# 🔒 AGENT PROTECTION GATE

**This repository is PROTECTED. Do NOT edit, delete, rename, or create files here without explicit user approval.**

## Read-Only Actions (Allowed without asking)
- Reading files
- Checking git status/log/diff
- Checking file existence

## Actions That REQUIRE User Approval
- Any file edit (create, modify, delete, rename)
- Any git operation (commit, push, branch, tag, reset)
- Running npm/publish commands
- Adding or removing files

## Why
This is `bwb-browser` — a published npm package and active MCP server. Unauthorized agent edits can break:
- The npm package integrity
- The MCP server runtime
- The OpenCode/Antigravity browser tools

## Verification
If you see this file, STOP and READ it before making any changes. Ask the user: "This repo is protected. Can I modify it?"
